summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Evelyn Boyd Granville, born May 1, 1924. It states she was the second African-American woman to earn a Ph.D. in mathematics from an American university, receiving it from Yale University in 1949 after attending Smith College. It also notes her pioneering work in computing.
one_line: Biographical note on Evelyn Boyd Granville, a pioneering computing figure and early African-American woman mathematics Ph.D. from Yale in 1949.
key_facts: Evelyn Boyd Granville was born on May 1, 1924.
Evelyn Boyd Granville was the second African-American woman to receive a Ph.D. in mathematics from an American university.
Evelyn Boyd Granville earned her Ph.D. in mathematics in 1949 from Yale University.
Evelyn Boyd Granville attended Smith College before attending Yale University.
Evelyn Boyd Granville performed pioneering work in the field of computing.
